thesis: An exceptionally profitable, near-net-cash ecosystem franchise with rising margins and a strong uptrend, priced above its own 5-year multiple range.
reason: Scorecard conviction 4: top quality, near-net-cash, wide moat and trend strength in place of a discount. The skew is modest and the de-rating risk real, so the evidence supports only the standard core size, which Python sets from volatility.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 30%, reversing the five-year expansion to 33.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 75%, back under the FY2023 level of 75.2%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 23%, under the FY2025 low of 23.7%.
Greater China net sales fall year on year in a 10-Q while iPhone net sales also fall.
